newsitem.title: EGYPT: Arafat in Cairo to brief Mubarak on Hebron deal.
newsitem.headline: Arafat in Cairo to brief Mubarak on Hebron deal.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat met Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak on Sunday to brief him on negotiations with Israel on the partial handover of the West Bank town of Hebron.
Presidential advisor Osama el-Baz escorted Arafat from Cairo airport to the Ittihadiya presidential palace where he met Mubarak.
The Palestinian leader was due to hold talks later in the day with Israeli Defence Minister Yitzhak Mordechai at the border between Israel and the Gaza Strip.

Palestinian and Israeli negotiators have said they expected Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Arafat to sign an agreement on the handover of 80 percent of Hebron to Palestinian rule by year's end.
The handover has been delayed by Netanyahu's demands for more stringent security for 400 Jewish settlers living in Hebron among more than 100,000 Arabs.
